name: note
description: Notes as the shared record between developer and agent, backed by the track CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the developer and the agent on the same page in a track vault.
interface.longDescription: A track vault is where the developer and the agent record what they both need to know: decisions, findings, and outstanding work. These skills create and search notes, write bodies in track's Markdown dialect, clip web pages into the vault, file research reports, keep those reports readable when they are written in Japanese, build single-file HTML tools a note can embed, and fold reports into explainer notes. Task handling lives in the task plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use $track-create-note to create a linked note in my vault.
Use $track-report to write up what you found as a report note.
Use $track-japanese-report-readability to make this Japanese report readable instead of exhausting.
Use $track-explainer to fold my reports on this topic into one explainer note.
Use $track-news-analysis to research this event from multiple lenses and file an analysis note.
Use $track-watch to run today's light brief (or this week's mid/high review) for my watch topic.
Use $track-markdown to write this note body in track's Markdown dialect.
Use $track-clip to read this URL and save it as a note.
Use $track-tool to build a small HTML tool this note can embed.
Use $track to rename a note and update backlinks.
